content.text: Paripadi Private Villa is a luxury villa in Bali offering a tranquil stay with direct rice field views. I designed and developed the official website to create an immersive brand experience while enabling a seamless direct booking flow.
The main goal was to increase direct bookings, reduce dependency on OTA platforms, and establish a strong premium brand presence through a calm and elegant digital experience.
I handled the project end-to-end, including UX strategy, UI design, WordPress development, and reservation plugin integration with a mobile-first and performance-optimized approach.

The information architecture was designed to guide users through a natural journey: Dream → Explore → Trust → Book. Clear CTAs and simplified booking steps were placed across key touchpoints to make the reservation process fast and intuitive.

The visual direction focuses on luxury and tranquility through full-width immersive imagery, generous white space, elegant typography, and warm natural tones to help users feel the atmosphere before arrival.
To balance high-quality visuals with performance, images were optimized using compression and lazy loading techniques, ensuring a smooth experience across devices, especially on mobile.
As a result, the website provides an independent direct booking channel, strengthens the villa’s premium positioning, and allows the client to easily manage content and promotions.

This project reinforced the importance of emotion-driven design in hospitality, the role of trust in direct booking conversion, and the efficiency of combining design and development in one unified workflow.
